sample_unit: panoramic radiographs (252, 251, 246 and 271 approximal sites for RBH measurement across models)

links.outcome: Agreement of general-purpose multimodal LLMs with clinicians on tooth counts and remaining bone height in panoramic radiographs
links.effect: Tooth count agreement was moderate to substantial (kappa 0.52-0.69). RBH was consistently overestimated (best ChatGPT 4.5: +12 pp distal, +11 pp mesial; LoA width ~54-60 pp). Accuracy was insufficient for clinical use.
links.quote: In the current stage of development, the ChatGPT models substantially overestimated the RBH values; therefore, they are not applicable for classifying periodontal disease.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and accuracy of several multimodal foundation models (ChatGPT versions) on periodontal radiograph interpretation compared to clinician consensus.
